annotations.title: Buy a projection from the agent's wallet

description: For an agent that pays from its own Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) wallet and has no fovub account: returns the payment link for one projection between two people for one seat, $1, paid with a Stripe Shared Payment Token. The paid answer starts the projection and carries its run_id; follow it with check_projection and answer_question, which need no sign-in for this run. An agent with the user's fovub sign-in uses start_projection instead. Needs no sign-in.
name: buy_projection
title: Buy a projection from the agent's wallet
